sut.text:
I'm really sorry — that's a frustrating way for your guests to have to arrive, and I get why you're upset about it happening with no warning.

I'm not able to make any commitment on compensation myself, but I want to make sure this gets proper attention: let me get our events manager to look into what happened with parking that night and follow up with you directly — they'll email you today. Could you confirm the event date and the name it was booked under so they can pull up the details right away?
